notes: Exalted: The Autochthonians supplied and inventory complete cover-to-cover. 207 rows reviewed and inventoried under docs/references/exalted1e/alchemical/inventory/: the Chapter Two character-creation overview (plus bonus-point/experience-cost tables), the universal Anima Effect/Anima Banner table, the Alchemical Physiology section (Artificial Metabolism, Life and Death, Refitting/Essence Advancement/Evolution), all five Castes (Orichalcum, Moonsilver, Jade, Starmetal, Soulsteel) plus the apocryphal Adamant Caste sidebar, the full Clarity Trait (gain/loss/effects table) and its Dissonance/Gremlin Syndrome mirror, the new/altered Backgrounds (Class, Vats, Artifact, Backing, Familiar, Manse) plus the Building Vats in Creation sidebar and the Followers/Influence/Resources exclusion note, all of Chapter Three (pp. 87-141/PDF 88-142, 94 Charms across all nine Charm trees plus the two General Charms and the Charm-system framing), the full Chapter Four weaving-protocol catalog (49 rows, printed pp. 142-159/PDF 143-160), the rest of Chapter Four's character-facing material (31 rows: the three Autochthonian-only alchemy formulae, the full Autochthonian Technology artifact catalog, and the full Warfare and Transportation sections, completing all of Chapter Four), and now the adventure-seed Chapters Five through Seven (reviewed and confirmed almost entirely GM/NPC/plot content, contributing exactly one more player-facing item, the Steamcar Refurbished vehicle). Chapter Four's Storyteller-side lore/NPC/setting material and Chapters Five-Seven's adventure narrative were reviewed and intentionally excluded as out of character-creation scope. No Alchemical-specific Merits/Flaws were found beyond Gremlin Syndrome/Dissonance anywhere in the book. Nothing promoted to a production catalog yet. Locked pending schema/rules/creator/editor implementation and passing tests across all five planned families.
